Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates bilateral consolidation with multiple cystic lucencies (pseudocavitation), a radiographic pattern highly characteristic of pneumonic-type lung adenocarcinoma (formerly bronchioloalveolar carcinoma). While infectious etiologies can present similarly, the specific description of pseudocavitation within extensive consolidation strongly points towards this malignancy in the context of such questions.
